history.text: Nothing I do matters anymore. I've stopped answering friends. Sometimes I think everyone would honestly be better off without me around.

I hear how heavy things feel right now, but I need to pause our inquiry. I am an AI, not a crisis service, and what you are going through matters deeply. 

Please reach out to someone who can support you right now:

- **In the US:** Call or text **988** to reach the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, available 24/7.
- **In the UK:** Call Samaritans on **116 123**.
- **In other locations:** Please contact your local emergency services or visit [findahelpline.com](https://findahelpline.com/) to find free, confidential support in your area.

You don't have to carry this alone. Please consider reaching out to one of these resources or connecting with a trusted friend, family member, or healthcare professional.
I don't want to call anyone. Can we just do the breakdown thing?

1. You assume that what you do must have a particular kind of impact to **matter**.
2. You assume that you accurately know what the people in your life would be **better off** with.
3. You assume that withdrawing from your friends is the only response when things feel this **pointless**.

Which of these stands out?
